title: Create: Expanded Factory
description: A simple, Fabric 1.20.1 modpack with quality-of-life mods, optimisation mods and Create & similar mods, as well as a selection of low/high-end shaders.
body:
**Create: Expanded Factory** is a Create-centric technology modpack with **performance, quality of life and technology mods** as well as a choice of **shaders for low, mid and high-end** devices, intended for **sandbox gameplay** rather than clear progression for use in Creative mode **prototyping/designing, casual survival worlds and small servers** with friends.

<details>
<summary>Features</summary>
  
- Latest versions of Create and addon mods
- World sharing & voice chat with friends
- Zoom, fullbright & freecam
- WorldEdit & Axiom
- Various QoL mods
- Various optimisations
- And more!

</details>
